attributes.headline: Keep the hook. Keep the context.
attributes.subhead: A narrow software-factory trial that turns one long-form creator video into an approved social clip pack through mechanical extraction, AI selection and generation, human editing, and auditable release gates.

cardInfo.name: Factory Trial 03 — CutRoom
cardInfo.summary: An attractive 5-reuse / 10-build proposal for a creator clip factory with source-grounded AI, human approval, and a publishable social pack.
cardInfo.notes: Proposal authored 2026-07-21. Reuse candidates are provisional until their live CardDefs pass the search-first gate. Realm-server capabilities are excluded from the artifact budget.
